note: review: parseString/stringParts (Peg/Strings.lean:241-275) follow string_parser.c:253-339, but StrReprRoundTrip covers only the token text repr writes: no prefix letters, no b/r/u, no triple quotes, no non-ASCII; the bytes branch (ASCII check \"bytes can only contain ASCII literal characters\", decode_bytes_with_escapes), raw mode and triple-quote stripping are unpinned, so a parse_string that mishandles bytes or r-strings satisfies it.
